_comment: kind: breaking (Breaking Point, bad) or second_wind (True Grit, good). Breaking: acts = what the hero may do on their own at the start of their turn (bark, pass, move_back, move_forward, random_skill, taunt); act_chance in %; refuses_help: may refuse heals/buffs/guards from allies; taunt_barks: lines for the taunt act. True Grit: turn_start boons with a chance in %. Any state: on_land = boons fired once when the state lands (in the fight it lands in, or the next fight), fight_start = boons fired at the start of every fight. Boon types: heal_self_pct, party_fatigue, buff_ally, buff_lowest (stat/value, the most wounded hero, rest of the fight), mark_self, mark_enemy (rounds), cleanse_ally (clears Bleed or Poison).

homesick.name: Heartsick
homesick.desc: Can't stop thinking about the farm back east. Slower and weaker, and may give up on a turn entirely.
barks: What are we even doing out here?
Ma's probably setting the table right now...
There's nothing out here but dirt and dying.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Throws caution to the wind. Hits harder but fights without cover (Vulnerable) and may charge in or lash out at random.

short_tempered.name: Ornery
short_tempered.desc: Spoiling for a fight. Gripes at the company and may call the whole enemy line onto themselves.
taunt_barks: I'll take the lot of ya!
barks: You call that a plan? You're an idiot.

cowardly.name: Cowardly
cowardly.desc: Wants to be anywhere else. Harder to hit and hangs back, but goes to pieces if pushed up front (Vulnerable in ranks 1-2).
barks: I... I think I hear the wagon calling.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.desc: Gold fever. Only cares about their cut and refuses help from anyone who might want a share. Their jingling saddlebags draw every eye: Marked at the start of each fight.
barks: That's MY share, don't touch it.
Nobody's getting rich off my back.
I'm counting the money after this. Twice.

paranoid.name: Paranoid
paranoid.desc: Sure the company is out to get them. Jumpy when a fight starts, refuses help and backs away from allies.
barks: You'd sell me out for a bent nickel.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc: Plants their feet like an old oak. Shields whoever is hurting worst (+15 Prot for the rest of the fight it lands in, or the next), then steadies the company.

inspired.name: Inspired
inspired.desc: Catches sight of the far horizon and remembers why they came. Lifts everyone's spirits.

sharp_eyed.name: Dead-Eye
sharp_eyed.desc: Everything slows down. Every shot counts, and they call out targets for the company.

grit.name: Mule-Headed
grit.desc: Too stubborn to quit. Shrugs off wounds and sickness, and hardest to kill on Last Legs.

fired_up.name: Fired Up
fired_up.desc: Blood's up and the fight's on. Hits harder, crits the exposed and rallies allies.

cool_headed.name: Cool-Headed
cool_headed.desc: Calm as a millpond. Takes healing well, shrugs off debuffs and talks the company through their wounds.
